item.title: 1 in custody after SWAT team responds to Northwest Side incident
item.description: <p>A person was placed in custody in an hourslong SWAT incident Sunday in the Northwest Side's Forest Glen neighborhood.</p><p>Officers were on the scene in the 7100 block of North Sioux Avenue around 10:20 a.m., Chicago police said. The incident ended around 8:30 p.m. </p><p>A person was placed in custody and was taken to Lutheran General Hospital for a mental health evaluation, police said. No injuries were reported. </p><p>No other information was available. </p>
